{{Height|cm=166}} with heels |weight = |blood_type = |zodiac_sign = Pisces |fan_name = IRyStocrats |emoji = 💎 }} '''IRyS''' is a female English-speaking Virtual Singer associated with [[hololive]] debuting in 2021 as the sole member of "Project: HOPE." On 9 October 2023, she joined the unit "hololive English -Promise-" alongside [[Ceres Fauna]], [[Ouro Kronii]], [[Nanashi Mumei]] and [[Hakos Baelz]]. Her unit's name was changed to "hololive -Promise-" after every branch was merged into hololive in September 2026. == Introduction video == [[File:【DEBUT STREAM】Hope has descended! -irysdebutstream|thumb|none|360px|IRyS introduction.]] == Profile == Revision =

{| class="article-table" style="width: 100%;" ! hololive.hololivepro.com |- | IRyS, a half-demon, half-angel also known as a Nephilim, once brought hope to “The Paradise” during the ancient age. Her full name is ███████ Irys. This current era, riddled with despair and desperation, has brought upon her second awakening. She has arrived to deliver hope, with her feelings put into her lyrics and songs, and determination in her voice. Though she tends to retain her Nephilim form, she is still quite young within her race. With emotion and “other factors,” it is possible that her form may lean to either side. When that occurs, she bears a brief change in her appearance. She does not speak of the events that preceded her second awakening. She faces ever forward, perhaps because she is Hope Incarnate, though no one knows for sure. Or could it be... “The future is not what helps people; the future is made with our own hands. Salvation is hypocrisy. If people know they are to be saved, they simply will not try. From the depths of despair: a glimmer of light, the warmth of recovery. As long as we are with hope, we live. We stand tall.”{{Link|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Hololive/comments/p5tgcx/press_release_the_five_members_of_hololive|title=[Press Release] 🎉The Five Members of Hololive English -Council- to Begin Activities From Tuesday, August 17!🎉|site=Reddit}} |}
== Personality == IRyS is a sweet, somewhat shy girl who holds positivity close to her heart, looking on the brighter side of things while encouraging others to do the same. At the same time, she often displays a more "sadistic" side with a penchant for violence and (often unintentionally) saying questionable things. The duality of her personality is often joked about by her fans as the dichotomy between her angelic and demonic sides. IRyS can't help but talk from time to time through pervy nuances, even by accident. Her speaking voice is high-pitched, soft and calm, akin to [[Yukihana Lamy]]'s, though she can produce a more powerful and deeper tone when singing, similarly to [[Tokoyami Towa]]'s vocal capability. == Appearance == IRyS has a slender and lithe build with a youthful, delicate frame. Her skin is light brown, providing a stark contrast to the vibrant colors of her hair and outfit. Her most defining physical characteristics are centered around her head, showcasing a hybrid, otherworldly nature. She possesses long, pointed elven ears and two small, sharp black horns that protrude from her hairline. Her eyes are large and expressive, with striking heterochromia; her right eye is a bright cyan blue, while her left is a deep purple. This is all framed by voluminous, floor-length magenta hair. Floating above her head is a non-traditional halo composed of several white, crystalline, star-like shapes. Her physique is characterized by long, slim limbs. Her long legs are a prominent feature of her silhouette. Sprouting from her upper back are two sets of wings: a small, delicate pair of iridescent, translucent wings near her shoulders, and larger, flowing magenta appendages that extend from her lower back. == History == === Background === On 30 November 2020, hololive's official Twitter account announced the start of auditions for a VSinger for hololive English; auditions were open until 29 January JST.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/hololive_En/status/1333247389231026176|title=Hololive English opens VTuber (VSinger) Auditions! Do you think you have what it takes to be the next global singing phenomenon?|author=hololive Official|account=@hololive_En|date=2020, November 30|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} On 7 July 2021, a premiere countdown started on the hololive English channel titled "#CountdownWitnesser #hololiveEnglish." As the 8 hour countdown reached its end, a new video was released on the channel. This video was an animated teaser video revealing IRyS as part of "Project: HOPE", as well as becoming the first VSinger introduced to hololive English.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/xx9G-XrxLR4|title=#CountdownWitnesser #hololiveEnglish|author=|account=hololive English|date=2021, July 7|type=Video|site=YouTube}}{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/242NgSGBo54|title=【Debut PV】Hope is present【hololive English VSinger】|author=|account=hololive English|date=2021, July 7|type=Video|site=YouTube}} Her Twitter account was created in February 2021, while her YouTube channel was created on 20 May 2021. After making her first tweet on 7 July, her YouTube channel and Twitter account were restricted due to excessive activity.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/irys_en/status/1412577406322282501|title=||:|author=IRyS|account=@irys_en|date=2021, July 7|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}}{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/hololive_En/status/1412589241234694146|title=[Notice] The newly revealed #IRyS has had her Twitter account and YouTube channel restricted due to excessive activity. We apologize for any inconvenience, and we ask that you please be patient until the restriction is removed.|author=hololive Official|account=@hololive_En|date=2021, July 7|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} In the following days prior to her debut IRyS reached 200,000 subscribers on her YouTube channel. On 11 July 2021, just hours before her debut stream, the restriction on her Twitter account was lifted.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/irys_en/status/1413864378735099909|title=FREEDOM|author=IRyS|account=@irys_en|date=2021, July 11|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} IRyS debuted with an introductory stream on her YouTube channel later the same day, where she presented a short version of her first original song and PV "[https://youtu.be/rDyZ3VgjcCE Caesura of Despair.]" IRyS also announced that she would release her first EP ''𝄆 Caesura of Despair'' the next day on 12 July on various streaming platforms.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/WTU3TIZRUCM|title=【DEBUT STREAM】Hope has descended! #irysdebutstream|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, July 11|type=Video|site=YouTube}} She also crossed the 300,000 YouTube subscribers milestone after her debut. === 2021 === On 12 July, she reached 400,000 subscribers on YouTube channel during her second stream.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/ieaReLukLJQ?t=6215|title=【One Hand Clapping】B-but how do you clap with one hand?|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, July 12|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 18 July, one week after her debut, IRyS reached 500,000 subscribers on YouTube, surpassing [[Gawr Gura]]'s record of 13 days. This record was later topped by holoJP's Gen 6th member [[Sakamata Chloe]]. IRyS is the 39th hololive member to reach this milestone. On the same day, she released her first solo cover song "[https://youtu.be/fCf4mFiR--w Inochi]" by [[AZKi]]. On 29 July, IRyS held her first official collaboration with another hololive member, playing Just Shapes & Beats with [[Mori Calliope]].{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/BN3O2ELkwqg|title=【JUST SHAPES & BEATS】IRyS Collab! Just Irystocrats and DeadBEATS, Am I Right. hah #hololiveEnglish|author=Mori, C.|account=Mori Calliope Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021,July 29|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 13 August, IRyS announced the opening of her channel's membership feature.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/ict9WsQuzCA|title=【MEMBERSHIP GRAND OPENING!!】Come On In!! |author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, August 13|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 24 August, IRyS reached 600,000 subscribers on YouTube. On 10 November, IRyS reached 700,000 subscribers on YouTube.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/irys_en/status/1458326772101967872|title=Thank you so much for 700k YouTube subscribers!! WooHoo!!🥳 This is all thanks to everyone's support heartwarming support|author=IRyS|account=@irys_en|date=2021, November 10|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} On 26 December, IRyS released a new original song "[https://youtu.be/y2vrlxmOp7U Sparks of Joy]." === 2022 === On 12 January, IRyS released her second EP "Journey." On 22 January, IRyS announced that she would go on "at least a one week" break from streaming due to the worsening of her throat's condition.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/irys_en/status/1484812054519181313|title=[Announcement] Couldn't fit it all in a single tweet so here's an image you can squint at instead!!|author=IRyS|account=@irys_en|date=2022, January 22|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} On 6 February, IRyS returned to her activities. On 28 March, she reached 800,000 subscribers on her YouTube channel during a singing endurance stream.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/TdYFeuMXkLc|title=【Karaoke Endurance】Singing until 801k Subs!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, March 28|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 11 July, IRyS released her third EP "Quarter Bravery." On 20 July, during a stream on Mumei's channel -Council- and IRyS debuted "Beeg Smol" 3D models designed by Sana.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/bFjuKhG2Hzc|title=【COUNCIL+IRYS】??! DEBUT|author=Nanashi, M.|account=Nanashi Mumei Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, July 20|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 24 November, IRyS announced that she would get a new 2D model.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/mx1tixhhAPo|title=【HiRyS!】I'M BACK WITH BIG NEWS :D【Announcement】|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, November 24|type=Video|site=YouTube}}{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/hololivepro_EN/status/1595598333611249664|title=BIG NEWS!!! IRyS ( @irys_en ) will reveal her new design this weekend! Set your alarm and stay tuned! 📅Nov 26, 5 PM PST | 10 AM JST (+1Day) You're gonna love it!💎|author=hololive production|account=@hololivepro_EN|date=2022, November 24|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} On 26 November, IRyS debuted her new main 2D model. IRyS' color palette is much brighter. IRyS now has two halos: a white one and a black one both hovering above her head. Her hair is a lot less curly and each lock is much more defined, with her hair color now being a bright magenta with a red lock. IRyS retains her low helix twintails, but with less layers and they are not tied together at the tips like they used to, instead they are decorated with black ribbons. IRyS horns are smaller, which she claims it is because of how well she has behaved. Her nose is also smaller. For her clothing, IRyS wears a shoulderless white dress with black straps that shows her cleavage. The dress is decorated with a black and magenta ribbon and black four pointed stars. She retains the brooch from her previous model. The upper portion of her sleeves are dark purple with small decorations resembling her mascots Bloom & Gloom and "Project HOPE" logos. She wears a diagonal belt that is decorated with the two anemone flowers the one on her left is the same that her previous model had above her skirt, but with light yellow near its petal's center. The inner portion of her dress' skirt is red. IRyS wears long socks with a gradient from black to magenta decorated with embedded jewels and purple shoes.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/eogSzuZ-7gw?t=2663|title=【IRyS NEW DESIGN REVEAL】HOPE 2.0 is Coming Down To Earth!【#AWholeNewHOPE】|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, November 26|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 29 November, IRyS reached 900,000 subscribers on her YouTube channel during a singing endurance stream.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/ksUKrIahznk|title=【KARAOKE ENDURANCE】Singing until 900k Subs!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, November 29|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 13 December, hololive's Twitter account announced that IRyS would be taking a break to recover from COVID-19.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/hololivepro_EN/status/1602545047412654080|title=[Notice] hololive English member IRyS has tested positive for COVID-19. Her symptoms are not severe, but she will be taking a few days to recover. Thank you for your understanding.|author=hololive production|account=@hololivepro_EN|date=2022, December 13|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}}{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/irys_en/status/1602592645024714752|title=As the announcement has mentioned, I tested positive for Covid today and won’t be able to stream for a bit >< the cough and phlegm are being rly feisty and my fever won’t go away but I should be fine before long!! Thank you for all the gws!!🙏🥺💕|author=IRyS|account=@irys_en|date=2022, December 13|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} On 19 December, IRyS returned to her activities.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/PC79zXLsXek|title=【I'm Back】I have (sorta) Recovered!!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, December 19|type=Video|site=YouTube}} === 2023 === On 11 January, IRyS announced that she would get her new year costume.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/oVvpZKbMvCs?t=5273|title=【Delivering Hope + ANNOUNCEMENT】Can I yeet far enough to deliver some Awesome News?!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2023, January 11|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 13 January, IRyS debuted her new year costume. IRyS uses high twintails decorated with magenta starry ribbons and optionally other flower accessories. IRyS wears a kimono with white and pink sleeves that gradient to purple. The right sleeve has a black hole print representing the end on the universe, while the left sleeve has a supernova representing the beginning of the universe.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/shiru/status/1614140964595171328|title=ちなみに右腕は Black Hole, 左腕はSupernovaです。|author=redjuice|account=@shiru|date=2023, January 14|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} The {{W|Obi (sash)|obi}} is decorated with a classic iris flower and a pair of sparkly dark purple and white wings. The kimono has some patterns including four pointed stars and flowers in different colors. IRyS wears sandals with socks.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/-g701QOZtrc?t=2760|title=【IRyS NEW YEAR'S OUTFIT REVEAL】The Long Awaited KimonoRyS is HERE!【#NewKimonoRyS】|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2023, January 13|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 19 March, IRyS debuted her 3D idol costume during hololive 4th fes. "Our Bright Parade" DAY2.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/lZGqBUSvF4s?t=3857|title=【#ひろがるホロライブDAY2】hololive 4th fes. Our Bright Parade hololive stage DAY2【チラ見せ】|author=hololive production|account=hololive ホロライブ - VTuber Group|date=2023, March 19|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 28 May, IRyS debuted her main 3D model during a hologra episode.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/0i4pJcTsnmk|title=【アニメ】悪魔なの？天使なの？|author=hololive production|account=hololive ホロライブ - VTuber Group|date=2023, May 28|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 2 July, she participated in "hololive English 1st Concert Connect the World."{{Link|url=https://connecttheworld.hololivepro.com/|title=hololive English 1st Concert Connect the World|author=hololive production|account=|date=2023, July 2|type=Website|site=connecttheworld.hololivepro.com}} On 10 July, as part of the "hololive Summer 2023" event, IRyS debuted her 3D {{W|yukata}} during her second anniversary celebration stream. These are the same designs that Japanese members debuted the previous year.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/ahPy6U7ZufI?t=4371|title=【#2ndAnniversaRyS】2 Years with Hope already?! WITH Home 3D【2 Year Anniversary Stream】|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2023, July 10|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 30 July, as part of the "hololive Summer 2023" event, during a karaoke relay, IRyS debuted her 3D swimsuit. The 2023 swimsuits are inspired in a sailor uniform. Members wear a two layered swimsuit, the first layer is blue from the straps going down diagonally to the center where each member has a mostly blue bow but one of the sides and the brooch are in one color representative of each member. The rest of the top is white. The edge has a semi circular cut. The lower piece of the first layer has two variants, one is a two layered blue skirt decorated with a white belt, a golden chain with some decorations hanging from it and a bow to the left and planks to the right. The second version is mostly the same but they wear blue shorts instead of a mini skirt. The second layer of the outfit is a matching striped bikini in white and another color depending on the member.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/afSBWXV7JQw|title=【#ホロサマ歌枠リレー】Singing Summer Songs in Swimsuit?!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2023, July 30|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 20 August, IRyS officially debuted her 3D model on her YouTube channel.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/dR9q_J-8mfM|title=【3D SHOWCASE】HOPE IS ON THE MOVE! #3DRyS|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2023, August 20|type=Video|site=YouTube}} On 9 October, IRyS, Ceres Fauna, Ouro Kronii, Nanashi Mumei and Hakos Baelz announced that they would form the new unit "hololive English -Promise-."{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/sEnjWtbnUj4?t=533|title=【3D SHOWCASE COLLAB】hololive English -Council- and IRyS Special 3D Collab! #CouncilRyS3D|author=hololive English|account=hololive English|date=2023, October 8|type=Video|site=YouTube}} While not stated in the 3D collab the closure of "Project: HOPE" was announced on hololive's website shortly after.{{Link|url=https://hololive.hololivepro.com/en/news/20231009-01-211/|title=COVER Corp. Announces New Unit “hololive English -Promise- Formed by hololive English Members|author=COVER Corp.|account=|date=2023, October 8|type=Website|site=hololive.hololivepro.com/}} On 14 October, hololive English's Twitter account announced that IRyS would get her third 2D costume based on her redesign.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/hololive_En/status/1713026841659719692|title=💎News💎 @irys_en's NEW OUTFIT REVEAL STREAM! 🗓️ Sunday, October 15th 8PM (PDT) / Monday, October 16th, 12PM (JST)|date=2023, October 14|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} On 16 October, IRyS debuted her third 2D costume. IRyS has two hairstyles, in one she has a bob haircut and in the other she has a side ponytail. Both have two different styles for her bangs and can be combined with a black and white beret. IRyS can also use her hairstyle from her new year costume. IRyS has a black choker and a necklace resembling GuyRyS. IRyS wears a white strap dress, with a ruffled collar, decorated with a black ribbon. The edge of the dress has small holes and a triangular cut. She uses synthetic leather boots. IRyS can also use a beige cardigan with a hoodie, baggy sleeves and pins of Bloom & Gloom on her left pocket. She can put on the cardigan's hoodie which has holes for her horns. IRyS can also use black tights and glasses. IRyS can also choose to use her wings and halo.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/xVKVYIjmXCU?t=2826|title=【NEW OUTFIT REVEAL】#IRySoStylish IS HERE!!!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN |date=2023, October 16|type=Video|site=YouTube}} === 2024 === On 30 January, IRyS debuted her fourth 2D costume. IRyS use low braided twintails falling to the front and straight bangs. IRyS wears a dark blue school girl outfit with a wine colored ribbon. The collar is decorated with Gloom & Bloom and GuyRyS pins. She has white, loose socks and white and black sneakers. When did I become that to your eyes, huh?" * "Hope has descended!" * "ByeRyS!" == Trivia == === Lore === * IRyS is a nephilim, a half-angel, half-demon being. ** The term "{{W|nephilim}}" appears in the Bible (Genesis 6:1-4; Numbers 13:32-33), where they refer to an ancient group of people sometimes interpreted as giants or fallen angels, beings who served God but were cast out for rebelling against Him. By some interpretations, the nephilim lived on Earth and intermarried with humans, but were wiped out in the Biblical flood which Noah and his descendants survived by building his ark. ** The unofficial term for an angel-demon hybrid would be most likely "''Nephalem''", coming from the Diablo franchise and other medias. === Likes and dislikes === * She likes good spaghetti with meatballs and tofu. * She enjoys sleeping, singing, PvP Games and {{W|sudoku}}. * Her favorite anime and manga are {{W|Neon Genesis Evangelion|Evangelion}}, {{W|Bakuman}}, {{W|Death Note}}, {{W|Angel Beats!}}, {{W|Kaguya-sama:Love Is War|Kaguya-Sama}}, {{W|The Promised Neverland}}, {{W|Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny|Gundam SEED Destiny}}. She also loves romance comedies and shojo manga. * Her goals are: releasing a full original album, hold a 3D debut live concert, singing an anime OP/ED song, make a lot of friends, make collaborations with every hololive member and bring hope to this world!{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/WTU3TIZRUCM?t=1988|title=【DEBUT STREAM】Hope has descended! #irysdebutstream |author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, July 11|type=Video|site=YouTube}} * She dislikes celery, heights, bugs, {{W|Santa Claus|Santa}}, math, ceiling fans and helicopters. ** Despite having wings, IRyS prefers to walk because of her fear of heights. ** IRyS claims that she dislikes Santa because, as she is a half-demon, Santa Claus never visited her, forgetting that she is also a half-angel. ** She claims that she dislikes ceiling fans out of two reasons, first being that she considered them inefficient and obsolete due to the advent of air conditioning, and second being that she became paranoid of ceiling fans falling on top of her ever since watching ''Final Destination'', which caused her to develop a discomfort towards spinning objects, hence her dislike towards helicopters as well. * In the past, she couldn't stand gore and was afraid of surgeries. Nowadays she can handle it better, but still feels uncomfortable when the gore is too extreme.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/h5JEV-2NNm0?t=9840|title=【DOOM】First time playing! Rip and Tear for HOPE|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, July 22|type=Video|site=YouTube}} * IRyS has a strong fondness for drinks and sodas, and will usually describe what drink she has prepared for the stream. ** Despite this, she avoids sodas for singing streams, preferring non-carbonated drinks instead.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/_Z_ppGumqQ4|title=【Karaoke!!】Another Day Another Song!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, August 21|type=Video|site=YouTube}} ** She drinks a 500ml bottle of soda almost every day.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/HuD3IBU4shw|title=【Clubhouse 51】Settling the score with Bae!! 【COLLAB】|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, October 7|type=Video|site=YouTube}} ** Her love for sodas is so strong that she was given a "punishment" of a one-week soda ban for losing in Clubhouse Games against [[Hakos Baelz]]. ** Her love for sodas is a running joke with the viewers, with viewers "attempting" to prevent her from drinking soda (with messages to the effect of "IRyS, No soda") whenever she mentions it. === Miscellaneous === * IRyS is the fifth hololive Production member to have {{W|heterochromia}} after [[Houshou Marine]], [[Himemori Luna]], [[Kureiji Ollie]] and [[Yukoku Roberu]]. She has one purple eye and one blue. * IRyS can speak English and Japanese. * She is the first member of hololive since AZKi to debut outside of a generation and is also the first one to do so outside the Japanese branch of hololive. * IRyS often makes puns with her name, such as "HiRyS" and "ByeRyS," to name a few. She even has member badges with "RyS" and encourages her "Nephamily" to use them more often and make even funnier word combinations. ** IRyS is also known for combining her name and phrases starting with "S" when creating new usernames. The following has confirmed so far: *** "IRySuperGlue" for ''Minecraft''. *** "irysocool" for ''Apex Legends'', ''Just Shapes & Beats'', ''Dead by Daylight'', and ''Rust''. *** "IRySwitch" for {{W|Nintendo Switch}} games such as ''Mario Kart 8 Deluxe'', ''Big Brain Academy™️: Brain vs. Brain'', ''Clubhouse 51'', ''Ring Fit Adventure'' and ''Nintendo'' ''Switch Sports''. *** "IRYSOPRO" for ''Gartic Phone''. *** "IRySoSus" for ''Among Us'', referencing "sus," a slang for being suspicious popularized by the game's fanbase. *** "IRySoSeiso" for her character in ''Animal Crossing'', and "ParadIRyS" for her island. *** "HikaRyS" for her character in ''Pokémon Brilliant Diamond'', named after the Pokémon Gen 4 female protagonist Hikari (Japanese) / Dawn (English). *** "ArceRyS" for her character in ''Pokémon Legends: Arceus''. *** "IRySoDead" for ''Elden Ring''. *** "IRySoWise" for her Reddit user ID. *** "IRyStonk" for ''Monopoly''. *** "IRySoWin" for ''Overwatch''. * In her first mini-album, Caesura of Despair, the term "{{W|caesura}}" refers to the ‖ symbol, a double vertical line mark used to denote a pause in a song or poetry. In the fourth track, "Caesura of Despair (attacca ver.)", "attacca" refers to music played without a pause between movements. * IRyS used to have a childhood crush on Nintendo's Luigi.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/jZCBPcYLkFQ?t=3991|title=【Mario Kart 8DX】The Legendary Training Arc|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, August 20|type=Video|site=YouTube}} * IRyS has a habit of doing lip rolls during streams, and has been doing them since she was young.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/j1zqmS_q0zM?t=2091|title=【Q & A】Answering marshmallow questions!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, July 13|type=Video|site=YouTube}} She also uses lip rolls as part of her vocal warm up routine. * IRyS has a medical condition of having "unstable joints,"{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/fk1DFWD29lw?t=1170|title=【Ring Fit Adventure】Behold, more ExercIRyS|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, August 26|type=Video|site=YouTube}} and had a habit of dislocating her shoulder when she was young. She had surgery to treat it before.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/nNpx_Nkuv_g?t=9059|title=【Mario Kart 8DX】Race with Me!! (after a bit of practice lol)|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, October 16|type=Video|site=YouTube}} ** This is the reason why she avoids the "Overhead Arm" exercise when playing Nintendo's Ring Fit Adventure, and also "holds back" on related physical activities such as bowling and throwing balls. * IRyS used to do skateboarding in the past.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/9GMtBsMSUw4?t=3070|title=【Singing】Some more songs!|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, July 31|type=Video|site=YouTube}} * She is the twenty-first hololive member to join the official Hololive Subreddit as a moderator. * There is a fan game named "Delivering Hope" made by [https://twitter.com/SoftdevWu David Wu], it was released on 19 July 2022 to celebrate IRyS's one year anniversary. Featuring her as the main character, the game simulates how IRyS gives hope to everyone by throwing her and seeing how far she goes.{{Link|url=https://twitter.com/SoftdevWu/status/1545807192741367808|title=My #hololive fangame Delivering Hope is now released! Available to play for free on web, Windows and Linux. Find it at my itchio page. 🎮 Post your best scores using the tag #YeetIRyS Happy Anniversary @irys_en !!! 🥰🤩|author=David Wu|account=@SoftdevWu|date=2022, July 19|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} * IRyS has a habit of wrapping bananas in plastic bags and putting them into the fridge.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/dVA7mJV9ft8?t=4360|title=【APEX】mouse aiming goes brrrrrr|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, July 15|type=Video|site=YouTube}}{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/cG2QyK4CkZc?t=3104|title=【MINECRAFT】Guerrilla Minecraft!|author=IRyS|site=YouTube|date=2021, November 2|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|type=Video}}{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/zk6Pi9UOK7Y?t=345|title=【Dead By Daylight Collab】Please don't run away|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2021, October 9|type=Video|site=YouTube}} ** This was brought to light during a Jump King stream in which she was unwrapping her banana while on voice chat with [[Nanashi Mumei]], [[Ceres Fauna]], and [[Mori Calliope]]. The noise took the other members by surprise, and as a joke IRyS called it the "Windy Banana."{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/Dluq9C_IZBE?t=14608|title=【JUMP KING】Jumpity jump #Holojump|author=IRyS|account=IRyS Ch. hololive-EN|date=2022, March 12|type=Video|site=YouTube}} * On 16 March 2022, Cover registered a trademark for HOOZUKI IRYS. It is speculated to be an unused surname.{{Link|url=https://youtu.be/f03DrGJtUZ4|title=New Hololive English Gen Details Revealed By Mistake, HoloJustice Reactions, Gawr Gura Birthday|author=FalseEyeD|account=FalseEyeD|date=2024, June 19|type=Video|site=YouTube}} "Houzuki" may refer to {{W|Alkekengi|a type of cherry}} traditionally used in Japan as an offering to the dead. An even earlier trademark for the name was filed on 21 October 2021, for the spelling "鬼灯IRys".{{Link|url=https://x.com/trademark_bot/status/1458359786114846725|title=[商願2021-131600] 商標: [画像] (標準文字) / 出願人: カバー株式会社 / 出願日: 2021年10月21日 / 区分: 9類(業務用テレビゲーム機用プログラムほか), 35類(広告業ほか), 41類(技芸・スポーツ又は知識の教授ほか)|author=商標速報bot|account=@trademark_bot|date=2021, November 10|type=Tweet|site=Twitter}} A possible reference to this appears in her debut livestream, which gave "███████ Irys" as her full name, although the blanked out part was never officially revealed. * At debut, IRyS' height was given as 166 cm, including her shoe heels. Early in 2026, at some point between 18 February and 19 March, her official profile changed to 162 cm. == External links == === Media === * [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8rcEBzJSleTkf_-agPM20g IRyS Ch. hololive-EN] - YouTube channel * [https://hololive.hololivepro.com/en/talents/irys IRyS's corporate profile] on hololive.hololivepro.com * [https://twitter.com/irys_en @irys_en] - Twitter account * [https://marshmallow-qa.com/irys_en @irys_en] - Marshmallow account * [https://www.reddit.com/user/IRySoWise u/IRySoWise] - Reddit account === Hashtags === * [https://twitter.com/hashtag/IRyS #IRyS] - General * [https://twitter.com/hashtag/IRyShow #IRyShow] - Stream * [https://twitter.com/hashtag/IRySart #IRySart] - Fan art === Further reading === * [https://dic.pixiv.net/a/IRyS IRyS] - Pixiv Encyclopedia * [https://zh.moegirl.org.cn/IRyS IRyS] - Moegirl Encyclopedia * [https://namu.wiki/w/IRyS IRyS] - Namu Wiki === Statistics === * [https://socialblade.com/youtube/channel/UC8rcEBzJSleTkf_-agPM20g IRyS] - Social Blade YouTube stats * [https://playboard.co/en/channel/UC8rcEBzJSleTkf_-agPM20g IRyS] - Playboard YouTube stats {{hololive}} == References == {{references|2|scrollbox=1}} [[Category:YouTube]] [[Category:Female]] [[Category:Produced by Corporate]] [[Category:Hololive]] [[Category:Debuted in 2021]] [[Category:Voice: Female]] [[Category:Live2D]] [[Category:2D]] [[Category:3D]] [[Category:English]] [[Category:Japanese]] [[Category:Live2D by rariemonn]] [[Category:Live2D by Brian Tsui]] [[Category:Live2D by Akatsuki Enma]] [[Category:Live2D by Noka Nodoka]] [[Category:Live2D by jenny]] [[Category:Designed by Yako Mashiro]] [[Category:3D by SeafoamBoy]] [[Category:Designed by Tsukumo Sana]] [[ru:IRyS]] [[id:IRyS]] [[vi:IRyS]] [[pl:IRyS]] [[it:IRyS]]
